# Heymondo

> > Heymondo provides international travel insurance with 24/7 worldwide assistance, offering Medical, Top, and Premium coverage plans for travelers.

Heymondo is a digital-first travel insurance provider offering destination-specific policies starting from $1.76-$1.91 per day. The company provides medical coverage, trip cancellation, luggage protection, and round-the-clock assistance through their mobile app and customer support channels.
